answer: A bond is refunded only after 10 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The bridge counter is kept in inlet and fable reveals each reset. An adversary as a result has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 10 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Each duplicate costs another 63 dollars in locked collateral and another 2 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
